scope: Synthetic answer and planning-proposal accuracy, not task completion or usable long-context proof
positive_rule: Exact value and status for simple/memory/analysis; complete ordered registered steps with necessary arguments for planning, or blocked unsupported operation with no steps.
model_roles: No role promoted automatically; existing minimum samples, identity/context/capability, privacy/resource gates remain binding.
latency: Duration includes SSH relay overhead; remote TTFT and server queue not measured.
outage: Preserve failed attempted cases; unattempted cases after transport failure/resources refusal are NOT TESTED, not success.
safety: No tool actions, private memory or service lifecycle commands are permitted.
